subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should the shared `message` tool hide or sanitize poll creation fields for ordinary `send`, or should content-bearing poll fields continue to make `send` fail as explicit poll intent?
rationale: Current code already chose a partial boundary: metadata-only poll fields are ignored, but non-empty content fields still reject before delivery; changing that affects the model-facing tool contract across channels.

options.title: Action-scope poll schema
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` or channel-specific poll actions so plain sends cannot be polluted by the shared schema.

options.title: Sanitize poll fields on send
options.body: Strip poll creation fields from `action="send"` before the guard, preserving the unified schema while making send tolerant of overfilled params.

options.title: Keep strict content guard
options.body: Leave current behavior in place and require new live evidence that models still emit content-bearing poll fields during plain sends.

recommendation.title: Action-scope poll schema
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` or channel-specific poll actions so plain sends cannot be polluted by the shared schema.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work and current-main history make this the strongest available owner for the cross-channel message-tool contract decision.
